summary.big_en: Say what you **do**, **did** and **are doing**.

glossary.def: The day before today.
glossary.example: What did you do yesterday?
glossary.example_vi: Hôm qua con đã làm gì?

glossary.def: The past of walk.
glossary.example: Yesterday, Peng walked to the park.
glossary.example_vi: Hôm qua Peng đã đi bộ tới công viên.

glossary.def: The past of play.
glossary.example: They played outside.
glossary.example_vi: Các bạn ấy đã chơi ngoài trời.

glossary.def: The past of go.
glossary.example: He went to school.
glossary.example_vi: Bạn ấy đã đi học.

glossary.def: The past of eat.
glossary.example: He ate noodles.
glossary.example_vi: Bạn ấy đã ăn mì.

glossary.def: The past of sing.
glossary.example: I sang a song.
glossary.example_vi: Tớ đã hát một bài hát.

points.t: **There is** for one, **there are** for many.
sub: **There is** one ruler. **There are** three jackets.

summary.big_en: Say **whose** it is, **where** and **when**.

points.t: **Possessive pronouns** stand alone, without the thing.
sub: This is my pencil. It is **mine**.
**This** box is mine. **That** box is yours.

summary.big_en: Count things, then **join** your ideas.

points.t: **an** before **a e i o u**; **a** before others.
sub: I see **an** octopus. That is **an** igloo.

points.t: **Plurals**: add **-s**, or **-es** after **sh ch s x**.

sub: Penguins swim fast, **but** they can't fly.

summary.big_en: Read the **sounds**, then **spell** the word.

glossary.def: The part between your head and body.
glossary.example: The duck has a long neck.
glossary.example_vi: Con vịt có cái cổ dài.

glossary.def: You wear it on your foot.
glossary.example: I put on my sock.
glossary.example_vi: Tớ đi tất vào.

glossary.def: A man who rules a country.
glossary.example: The king has a crown.
glossary.example_vi: Nhà vua đội vương miện.

glossary.def: A bird uses it to fly.
glossary.example: The bird has two wings.
glossary.example_vi: Con chim có hai cánh.

glossary.def: A woman who rules a country.
glossary.example: I can see a queen.
glossary.example_vi: Tớ nhìn thấy một nữ hoàng.

glossary.def: A thick, warm cover for a bed.
glossary.example: I sleep under my quilt.
glossary.example_vi: Tớ ngủ dưới chăn bông.

glossary.def: A thin piece of wood.
glossary.example: The dog has a stick.
glossary.example_vi: Chú chó ngậm một cái que.

glossary.def: Tiny bits of rock on a beach.
glossary.example: We play in the sand.
glossary.example_vi: Chúng tớ chơi cát.

summary.big_en: Write neat sentences with **capitals** and **full stops**.

sub: **She** is a doctor. **He** is a bus driver.

summary.big_en: Where can you see **words**? Look around your classroom.

glossary.def: Pages of words and pictures, held together.
glossary.example: When I open up a book, each page whispers, 'Look! Look! Look!'
glossary.example_vi: Khi em mở một quyển sách, mỗi trang thì thầm: 'Nhìn kìa!'

glossary.def: A drawing that shows where places are.
glossary.example: There is a world map and a calendar on the wall.
glossary.example_vi: Trên tường có một tấm bản đồ thế giới và một tờ lịch.

glossary.def: A chart of the days and months.
glossary.example: There is a calendar on the wall.
glossary.example_vi: Trên tường có một tờ lịch.

glossary.def: A thing on the wall that shows the time.
glossary.example: Point to the clock, please!
glossary.example_vi: Hãy chỉ vào cái đồng hồ nào!

glossary.def: A small flat computer you touch with your finger.
glossary.example: There is a tablet in our classroom.
glossary.example_vi: Trong lớp của chúng em có một máy tính bảng.

glossary.def: The first day of the school week.
glossary.example: On Mondays we learn music.
glossary.example_vi: Thứ Hai chúng em học nhạc.

glossary.def: The day after Monday.
glossary.example: Good morning! Today is Tuesday.
glossary.example_vi: Chào buổi sáng! Hôm nay là thứ Ba.

glossary.def: The day after Tuesday.
glossary.example: What day is it today? It's Wednesday.
glossary.example_vi: Hôm nay là thứ mấy? Là thứ Tư.

glossary.def: The day after Wednesday.
glossary.example: Do you go to school on Thursday?
glossary.example_vi: Thứ Năm em có đi học không?

glossary.def: The last day of the school week.
glossary.example: On Fridays we learn English.
glossary.example_vi: Thứ Sáu chúng em học tiếng Anh.

glossary.def: The day after Friday, when there is no school.
glossary.example: On Saturdays and Sundays, we do art.
glossary.example_vi: Thứ Bảy và Chủ nhật, chúng em vẽ tranh.

glossary.def: The day after Saturday, when there is no school.
glossary.example: Sunday is the last day of the week.
glossary.example_vi: Chủ nhật là ngày cuối cùng của tuần.

sub: We go to school from **Monday** to **Friday**.

summary.big_en: Talk about **time**, **days** and **school activities**.

glossary.def: A table where you sit and work at school.
glossary.example: I tidy up my desk.
glossary.example_vi: Em dọn bàn học của mình.

glossary.def: A machine with a screen and a keyboard.
glossary.example: There is a computer on the desk.
glossary.example_vi: Có một cái máy tính trên bàn.

glossary.def: A small thing that rubs out pencil marks.
glossary.example: A rubber is also called an eraser.
glossary.example_vi: Cục tẩy còn được gọi là eraser.

glossary.def: A coloured wax stick for drawing.
glossary.example: There are two crayons.
glossary.example_vi: Có hai cây bút sáp màu.

glossary.def: A tool with two blades for cutting paper.
glossary.example: Cut the paper with scissors.
glossary.example_vi: Cắt giấy bằng kéo.

points.t: What time is it? **It's three o'clock.**
**Present simple**: one person, add **-s** to the verb.
**Plurals**: add **-s**, or **-es** after **sh ch s x**.
**Punctuation**: a sentence begins with a **capital letter**.
sub: **I**, names and days have capitals too.
End with a **full stop** or a **question mark**.

summary.big_en: Every book has a **title** and an **author**.

glossary.def: The name of a book or story.
glossary.example: What is the title of the book?
glossary.example_vi: Tên quyển sách này là gì?

glossary.def: The writer of a book.
glossary.example: Who is the author of the book?
glossary.example_vi: Ai là tác giả của quyển sách?

glossary.def: A page that tells you what is in a book.
glossary.example: A contents page is at the beginning of a book.
glossary.example_vi: Trang mục lục nằm ở đầu quyển sách.

glossary.def: One part of a book.
glossary.example: There are four chapters in this book.
glossary.example_vi: Quyển sách này có bốn chương.

points.t: The **title** is the name of a book.
A **contents page** is at the beginning of a book.
sub: It tells you what is in the book.

points.t: There are four **chapters** in this book.
sub: Find the chapter, then turn to its **page**.

summary.big_en: **Whose** is it? It's **Lucy's**. It's **mine**.

glossary.def: A bag you carry on your back.
glossary.example: Lucy's backpack is red.
glossary.example_vi: Ba lô của Lucy màu đỏ.

glossary.def: A round thing you kick, throw or catch.
glossary.example: He has a ball in his backpack.
glossary.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một quả bóng trong ba lô.

glossary.def: A rope you jump over again and again.
glossary.example: This is Oscar's skipping rope.
glossary.example_vi: Đây là dây nhảy của Oscar.

glossary.def: You use it to talk to people far away.
glossary.example: It's Jim's phone.
glossary.example_vi: Đó là điện thoại của Jim.

glossary.def: A warm top you pull over your head.
glossary.example: She has a yellow jumper.
glossary.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một chiếc áo len màu vàng.

glossary.def: A thin stick you write and draw with.
glossary.example: The red pencil is mine.
glossary.example_vi: Cái bút chì đỏ là của em.

glossary.def: A box you carry your lunch in.
glossary.example: She has a lunchbox in her backpack.
glossary.example_vi: Bạn ấy có một hộp cơm trưa trong ba lô.

glossary.def: A small book of empty pages for writing in.
glossary.example: It's Anna's notebook.
glossary.example_vi: Đó là quyển vở của Anna.

glossary.def: Dark glasses you wear when the sun is bright.
glossary.example: He has sunglasses in his backpack.
glossary.example_vi: Bạn ấy có kính râm trong ba lô.

glossary.def: Something you wear on your head.
glossary.example: His hat is black.
glossary.example_vi: Mũ của bạn ấy màu đen.

glossary.def: A small metal thing that opens a lock.
glossary.example: He has two keys.
glossary.example_vi: Bạn ấy có hai chiếc chìa khoá.

points.t: Say **one** so you don't say the thing again.
A girl: **her** backpack. A boy: **his** backpack.
**This** box is mine. **That** box is yours.

summary.big_en: Some letters are **consonants** and some are **vowels**.

glossary.def: The five letters A, E, I, O and U.
glossary.example: A, E, I, O and U are vowels.
glossary.example_vi: A, E, I, O, U là các nguyên âm.

glossary.def: Any letter that is not a vowel.
glossary.example: Some letters are called consonants and some are called vowels.
glossary.example_vi: Có những chữ cái gọi là phụ âm và có những chữ gọi là nguyên âm.

glossary.def: A round red or green fruit.
glossary.example: It's an apple.
glossary.example_vi: Đó là một quả táo.

glossary.def: The round thing a bird lays, which we can eat.
glossary.example: Egg starts with the short e sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ egg bắt đầu bằng âm e ngắn.

glossary.def: A small animal with six legs, like an ant.
glossary.example: Insect starts with the short i sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ insect bắt đầu bằng âm i ngắn.

glossary.def: A sea animal with eight arms.
glossary.example: It's an octopus.
glossary.example_vi: Đó là một con bạch tuộc.

glossary.def: A thing you hold over your head in the rain.
glossary.example: Umbrella starts with the short u sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ umbrella bắt đầu bằng âm u ngắn.

glossary.def: A big boat that carries people across the sea.
glossary.example: Ship begins with the sh sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ ship bắt đầu bằng âm sh.

glossary.def: A place where you buy things.
glossary.example: Shop begins with the sh sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ shop bắt đầu bằng âm sh.

glossary.def: A hard cover a sea animal lives in.
glossary.example: Shell begins with the sh sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ shell bắt đầu bằng âm sh.

glossary.def: An animal that lives and swims in water.
glossary.example: It's a fish.
glossary.example_vi: Đó là một con cá.

glossary.def: Long thin pieces of potato that are cooked in oil.
glossary.example: Chips begins with the ch sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ chips bắt đầu bằng âm ch.

glossary.def: A food made from milk.
glossary.example: Cheese begins with the ch sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ cheese bắt đầu bằng âm ch.

glossary.def: To take hold of something moving through the air.
glossary.example: Catch ends with the letters tch.
glossary.example_vi: Từ catch kết thúc bằng cụm chữ tch.

glossary.def: The lesson where you work with numbers and shapes.
glossary.example: Maths ends with the th sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ maths kết thúc bằng âm th.

glossary.def: Coming after the fourth one.
glossary.example: Fifth ends with the th sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ fifth kết thúc bằng âm th.

glossary.def: The short thick finger on your hand.
glossary.example: Thumb begins with the th sound.
glossary.example_vi: Từ thumb bắt đầu bằng âm th.

sub: Sing the **ABC** song: A to Z.

points.t: Hear the short vowel in the **middle**.

sub: At the start or the end: **shed**, **rush**

summary.big_en: I can read and write about **schools**.

glossary.def: The lesson where you learn how things work.
glossary.example: I like science class.
glossary.example_vi: Em thích giờ khoa học.

glossary.def: A big hole with water where you swim.
glossary.example: We swim in the school pool.
glossary.example_vi: Chúng em bơi ở bể bơi của trường.

glossary.def: To look at words and understand them.
glossary.example: The children read. Marco reads.
glossary.example_vi: Các bạn đọc. Marco đọc.

glossary.def: To have fun with games and toys.
glossary.example: We play outside at break time.
glossary.example_vi: Giờ ra chơi chúng em chơi ở ngoài sân.

sub: I write alone: **my** book. We write together: **our** book.

summary.big_en: **Neighbours** live and work near your home.

glossary.def: A person who lives near you.
glossary.example: There are neighbours helping neighbours in my neighbourhood.
glossary.example_vi: Có những người hàng xóm giúp đỡ nhau trong khu phố của em.

glossary.def: The streets around your home.
glossary.example: Come and meet the people in my neighbourhood.
glossary.example_vi: Hãy đến gặp những người trong khu phố của em.

glossary.def: A person who cleans windows.
glossary.example: The window cleaner is cleaning the window.
glossary.example_vi: Chú lau kính đang lau cửa sổ.

glossary.def: A person who helps keep people safe.
glossary.example: What is the police officer doing?
glossary.example_vi: Chú cảnh sát đang làm gì?

glossary.def: A person who tells us the news.
glossary.example: The reporter is talking to the footballer.
glossary.example_vi: Phóng viên đang nói chuyện với cầu thủ bóng đá.

glossary.def: A person who looks after sick people.
glossary.example: Who is the nurse helping?
glossary.example_vi: Cô y tá đang giúp ai?

glossary.def: A person who drives a bus.
glossary.example: The bus driver is driving the bus.
glossary.example_vi: Bác tài xế đang lái xe buýt.

points.t: My **neighbourhood** is the streets around my home.
Ask **What** to find out the action.
sub: What is the police officer doing?

points.t: Ask **Who** to find out the person.

sub: The **bus driver** is driving the bus.

summary.big_en: **Firefighters** wear special clothes that keep them safe.

glossary.def: A person who puts out fires.
glossary.example: Firefighters have important jobs. They put out fires.
glossary.example_vi: Lính cứu hoả có công việc quan trọng. Họ dập lửa.

glossary.def: To save someone from danger.
glossary.example: They rescue people who are inside burning buildings.
glossary.example_vi: Họ cứu những người đang ở trong toà nhà cháy.

points.t: Use **he** for a man, **she** for a woman.

summary.big_en: Say where you live: **city**, **country**, **continent**.

glossary.def: A home inside a big building.
glossary.example: I live in an apartment building.
glossary.example_vi: Em sống trong một toà chung cư.

glossary.def: One level of a building.
glossary.example: My family lives on the second floor.
glossary.example_vi: Gia đình em sống ở tầng hai.

glossary.def: A very big town.
glossary.example: I live in Mexico, in a city called Merida.
glossary.example_vi: Em sống ở Mexico, trong một thành phố tên là Merida.

glossary.def: A very big area of land.
glossary.example: Africa is a continent.
glossary.example_vi: Châu Phi là một châu lục.

points.t: My **address** goes from small to big.

sub: My family lives on the second **floor**.

summary.big_en: Use place words to say **where** things are.

glossary.def: At the side of something.
glossary.example: It's next to the shoe shop.
glossary.example_vi: Nó ở ngay cạnh cửa hàng giày.

glossary.def: With one thing on each side.
glossary.example: It's between the bookshop and the sweet shop.
glossary.example_vi: Nó nằm giữa hiệu sách và cửa hàng kẹo.

glossary.def: On the other side, facing it.
glossary.example: It's opposite the gift shop.
glossary.example_vi: Nó ở đối diện cửa hàng quà tặng.

glossary.def: At the back of something.
glossary.example: Look behind the door.
glossary.example_vi: Hãy nhìn phía sau cánh cửa.

glossary.def: At the front of something.
glossary.example: Look in front of the crayons.
glossary.example_vi: Hãy nhìn phía trước hộp bút màu.

glossary.def: With something over it.
glossary.example: Look under the teacher's chair.
glossary.example_vi: Hãy nhìn dưới ghế của cô giáo.

glossary.def: Higher than something.
glossary.example: The bee is above the flowers.
glossary.example_vi: Con ong ở phía trên những bông hoa.

glossary.def: Lower than something.
glossary.example: The table is below the vase.
glossary.example_vi: Cái bàn ở phía dưới bình hoa.

glossary.def: Forward, without turning.
glossary.example: Go straight ahead.
glossary.example_vi: Đi thẳng.

glossary.def: Change direction to your right.
glossary.example: At the end, turn right.
glossary.example_vi: Đến cuối đường thì rẽ phải.

glossary.def: Change direction to your left.
glossary.example: At the end, turn left.
glossary.example_vi: Đến cuối đường thì rẽ trái.

glossary.def: A big building with many shops inside.
glossary.example: Look at the map of the shopping centre.
glossary.example_vi: Hãy nhìn bản đồ trung tâm mua sắm.

points.t: **on** means touching the top of something.
sub: The cat is on the farmer's shoulder.

points.t: **behind**: at the back. **in front of**: at the front.
sub: Look in front of the crayons.

points.t: **next to** means at the side of something.
sub: The bus driver is **next to** the nurse.

points.t: **between** has one thing on each side.
sub: It's between the bookshop and the sweet shop.

points.t: **opposite** means on the other side, facing.

sub: The bee is above the flowers.
The table is below the vase.
Put your finger on the red star.
Go straight ahead. At the end, turn right.

points.t: Things can be **on the left** or **on the right**.
sub: Which shops are on your left?

points.t: Ask politely: **Excuse me, where is** the …?
sub: Excuse me, where is the gift shop?

summary.big_en: **er**, **ir**, **or**, **ur** can make the same sound.

glossary.def: A person who sings.
glossary.example: I'm a singer. I sing.
glossary.example_vi: Em là ca sĩ. Em hát.

glossary.def: A person who teaches.
glossary.example: I'm a teacher. I teach.
glossary.example_vi: Em là giáo viên. Em dạy học.

glossary.def: A person who acts in plays and films.
glossary.example: I'm an actor. I act.
glossary.example_vi: Em là diễn viên. Em diễn.

glossary.def: A person who writes books.
glossary.example: I'm a writer. This is a story about a tiger.
glossary.example_vi: Em là nhà văn. Đây là truyện về một con hổ.

glossary.def: A person who works on boats.
glossary.example: I am a sailor. I got a sailboat for my birthday.
glossary.example_vi: Em là thuỷ thủ. Em được tặng một chiếc thuyền buồm vào sinh nhật.

glossary.def: A person who makes pretty pictures.
glossary.example: I am a painter. I paint pictures.
glossary.example_vi: Em là hoạ sĩ. Em vẽ tranh.

glossary.def: A person who makes bread.
glossary.example: I am a baker. I bake bread.
glossary.example_vi: Em là thợ làm bánh. Em nướng bánh mì.

glossary.def: A person who likes to watch birds.
glossary.example: I am a birdwatcher. I like to watch birds.
glossary.example_vi: Em là người ngắm chim. Em thích ngắm chim.

glossary.def: A person who makes sick people better.
glossary.example: She is a doctor.
glossary.example_vi: Cô ấy là bác sĩ.

glossary.def: A person who dances.
glossary.example: I dance. I am a dancer.
glossary.example_vi: Em nhảy múa. Em là vũ công.

glossary.def: A person who grows and sells vegetables.
glossary.example: I farm. I am a farmer.
glossary.example_vi: Em làm nông. Em là nông dân.

glossary.def: A person who builds houses.

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right words: ___ one ruler on my table.
quiz.why_en: One ruler is a single thing, so you use There is (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right words: ___ three jackets on the chair.
quiz.why_en: Three jackets is more than one, so you use There are (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Which question asks about the number of chairs?
quiz.why_en: How many asks about number (p.15).

quiz.stem_en: Which classroom object shows the days and months of the year?
quiz.why_en: A calendar is a chart that shows the days and months (p.14).

quiz.stem_en: You want to find your country. Which classroom object do you look at?
quiz.why_en: A map is a drawing that shows where places are (p.14).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right word: The children ___ every morning.
quiz.why_en: The children means they, so the verb takes no -s (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right word: Marco ___ a book on Tuesday.
quiz.why_en: Marco is he, so the verb takes -s (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: When does a present simple verb take an extra -s?

choices.en: When the subject is I or you
When the subject is he, she or it
When the subject is we or they

quiz.why_en: The children sing, but Marco sings: he, she and it take -s (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: Which day comes straight after Monday?
quiz.why_en: Tuesday is the day after Monday (p.16).

quiz.stem_en: What are the people or animals in a story called?
quiz.why_en: The people or animals in a story are called characters (p.17).

quiz.chu_de: truyện tưởng tượng vs thông tin
quiz.stem_en: A book tells about a talking snowman who goes to the moon. What kind of book is it?
quiz.why_en: Stories are not real; they are make-believe (p.17).

quiz.stem_en: What is the title of a book?

choices.en: The last page of the book

quiz.why_en: The title is the name of a book or story (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: Who is the author of a book?
quiz.why_en: The author is the writer (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: Where is the contents page, and what does it do?

choices.en: At the end, and it tells you who wrote the book
At the beginning, and it tells you what is in the book
In the middle, and it shows the pictures
On the cover, and it gives the title

quiz.why_en: A contents page is at the beginning of a book and tells you what is in it (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: A contents page reads: 1 School uniforms 2, 2 First day of school 6, 3 Art class 10, 4 Lunchtime 14. Which page do you turn to for art class?
quiz.why_en: The contents page shows chapter 3, Art class, starting on page 10 (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: What is one chapter of a book?

choices.en: One part of the book, with its own name

quiz.why_en: There are four chapters in the book, and each has its own title (p.18).

quiz.stem_en: Choose the right words: This backpack belongs to Lucy. It is ___ backpack.
quiz.why_en: Add 's to the owner's name: Lucy's backpack is red (p.20).

quiz.stem_en: Say this in a shorter way: Yes, it's my backpack.
quiz.why_en: Mine replaces my backpack (p.20).

quiz.stem_en: Say this in a shorter way: Is this your backpack?
quiz.why_en: Yours replaces your backpack (p.20).

quiz.stem_en: Which thing in a backpack do you carry your lunch in?
quiz.why_en: A lunchbox is a box you carry your lunch in (p.21).

quiz.stem_en: It is cold in the classroom. Which of these do you put on?
quiz.why_en: A jumper is a warm top you pull over your head (p.21).

quiz.stem_en: Which five letters are the vowels?
quiz.why_en: A, E, I, O and U are vowels; the other letters are consonants (p.22).

quiz.stem_en: Which word starts with the short u sound?
quiz.why_en: Umbrella starts with the short u sound (p.22).

quiz.stem_en: Which word starts with the short o sound?
quiz.why_en: Octopus starts with the short o sound (p.22).

quiz.stem_en: Which word begins with the sh sound?
quiz.why_en: Ship begins with the sh sound (p.23).

quiz.stem_en: Which two words end with the same sound?
quiz.why_en: Maths and fifth both end with the th sound (p.23).

quiz.stem_en: Your partner points at a picture and asks, 'How do you spell it?' What do you do?

choices.en: Say the letters of the word one by one
Say the word in your home language
Count how many pictures there are

quiz.why_en: You answer by saying the letters, such as p-e-n (p.23).

quiz.stem_en: Fernando writes his book by himself. Which words does he use?
quiz.why_en: Fernando wrote his book by himself, so he uses I and my (p.27).

quiz.stem_en: Your class writes a chapter together. Choose the right sentence.

choices.en: Our teacher's name is Ms Cruz.
My teacher's name is Ms Cruz.
I teacher's name is Ms Cruz.
Their teacher's name is Ms Cruz.

quiz.why_en: A group writing together uses we and our (p.27).

quiz.stem_en: In science class the children use batteries and wires. What do they make happen?

choices.en: They make a light bulb turn on
They make a picture for the wall

quiz.why_en: We use batteries and wires to make a light bulb turn on (p.25).

quiz.stem_en: A child puts the science materials away carefully and remembers her homework. What does this show?
quiz.why_en: Using materials safely and remembering your homework are ways of being responsible (p.26).

quiz.stem_en: What is your neighbourhood?

choices.en: The country you were born in

quiz.why_en: A neighbourhood is the streets around your home (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: Whose job is it to look after people who are ill?
quiz.why_en: A nurse looks after people who are ill (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: Whose job is it to find out news and tell people about it?

quiz.stem_en: Your aunt's son is what to you?

quiz.stem_en: Which question word do you use to ask about a person?

quiz.stem_en: Which question would you ask to find out an action?

choices.en: What is the police officer doing?
Where is the police officer from?

quiz.why_en: What? asks about the action (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: A poem says there are neighbours helping neighbours. What is it about?

choices.en: The people who live near each other

quiz.why_en: The poem My neighbourhood is about the people on the streets around home (p.31).

quiz.stem_en: What is a firefighter's job?

choices.en: To put out fires and rescue people

quiz.why_en: Firefighters put out fires and rescue people from burning buildings (p.32).

quiz.stem_en: Why does a firefighter wear a mask and an air pack?

quiz.stem_en: Why do firefighters wear heavy gloves?

quiz.stem_en: Firefighters' jackets are made from special material. What is special about it?

quiz.stem_en: Josef asks a firefighter questions to find out about her job. What is he doing?

quiz.stem_en: Josef writes down what he found out about Miss Dilov's job. What is that piece of writing called?

quiz.stem_en: Silvia's family lives on the second floor. What does floor mean here?
quiz.why_en: A floor is one level of a building (p.34).

quiz.stem_en: What is the capital of a country?
quiz.why_en: The capital is the most important city of a country (p.34).

quiz.stem_en: Mexico is in North America. What is North America?
quiz.why_en: North America is a continent (p.35).

quiz.stem_en: You want to reach the fourteenth floor of a tall building. What do you use?
quiz.why_en: A lift carries you up and down a tall building (p.35).

quiz.stem_en: On the map, Merida is in square D-2. What does a map show you?
quiz.why_en: A map is a drawing that shows where places are (p.34).

quiz.stem_en: A shop has the bookshop on one side and the sweet shop on the other. Where is it?
quiz.why_en: Between means with one thing on each side (p.36).

quiz.stem_en: A shop is on the other side of the walkway, facing the gift shop. Which word says that?
quiz.why_en: Opposite means on the other side, facing something (p.36).

quiz.stem_en: A clue says to look at the back of the door. Which word means that?
quiz.why_en: Behind means at the back of something (p.37).

quiz.stem_en: A clue says to look below the teacher's chair. Which word means that?
quiz.why_en: Under means below something (p.37).

quiz.stem_en: You are following a map and must go forwards without turning. What do you say?

quiz.stem_en: How do you politely start asking a stranger for directions?

choices.en: You tell me the gift shop.
Excuse me, where is the gift shop?

quiz.why_en: Excuse me makes the question polite (p.36).

quiz.stem_en: You add -er to the verb sing. What word do you get?

quiz.stem_en: You add -or to the verb act. What word do you get?

quiz.stem_en: What do the spellings -er, -ir, -or and -ur have in common?

They can all stand for the same sound

quiz.stem_en: A person who bakes bread is called what?

quiz.stem_en: Which of these words has the -ur spelling of that sound?

quiz.stem_en: In the poem, what does the phrase a lot of mean?

quiz.stem_en: Which word beginning with un- means sad?

quiz.stem_en: Silvia lives on floor number two. Which word gives that as a position?
